# FairDM's vocabularies, as published

Copies of the nine vocabularies in
[FAIR-DM/fairdm-vocabularies](https://github.com/FAIR-DM/fairdm-vocabularies), taken from its
`vocabularies/` directory at commit
[`c19b9cc`](https://github.com/FAIR-DM/fairdm-vocabularies/commit/c19b9cc5311856ad4d0d467f5bf0a263364f3600).

The test suite and the demo portal load them from here, through `CONTROLLED_VOCABULARIES` in
`config/settings.py`, so no test fetches anything over the network. Replace a file with the
published one to update it, and never edit one here.
